bio: Adjunct Assistant Professor of Epidemiology Epidemiology, Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health Departments Department of Epidemiology I am a prostate cancer researcher and epidemiologist with joint appointments at Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health, Brigham and Women's Hospital, and Karolinska Institutet. My research aims at improving genetic risk stratification for prostate cancer, in particular aggressive disease, and at understanding if a high genetic risk can be offset by adherence to a healthy lifestyle. MSc, Biomedical Science Uppsala University
